description:
Solve your own wire antenna with the NEC-2 method of moments: dipoles, Yagis, verticals and loops, element by element.
Inputs: Units, ranges and defaults are in each parameter's schema; one left out takes its default. Free lane: solveMode cannot be optimize without a paid key. Cross-parameter checks: sweep_stop_after_start. Time budget 1200 s; waitSeconds (default 90, max 600) bounds the wait.
Example: {"solveMode":"instant","freq":146000000}
Returns: Peak gain, front-to-back ratio, beamwidths, feed impedance and VSWR (per frequency on a sweep, with the VSWR bandwidth), the azimuth and elevation patterns described as series, and for Optimize the recommended design and its Pareto front. Also warnings, provenance and the result page link; series are described, not listed (full: true returns everything). If waitSeconds runs out first: the jobId and progress, and the job keeps running.
Runs as a job on rftools.io and counts against the monthly run allowance (free lane without a key).

antennaType.description: Closed-Form Model. Which textbook model Instant evaluates. Instant has no model for other geometries. omit for the default of "dipole". Applies when solveMode is "instant". Advanced — most callers can leave it out

conductor.description: Conductor. Object {material: copper | aluminium | perfect | custom}, plus conductivity (S/m) when custom. Omit for copper. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

feed.description: Feed Point. Which wire and segment the source drives. Required for every mode but Instant. Object {wire, segment}, both 0-based: which wire the source drives, and which segment of it. Not on the web form, which has an editor for it — give it here as described

freq.description: Frequency (Hz). min 1000. omit for the default of 146000000

freqPoints.description: Sweep Points. How many frequencies the sweep solves. min 2, max 2001. omit for the default of 51. Applies when solveMode is "sweep". Advanced — most callers can leave it out

freqStart.description: Sweep Start (Hz). Lower bound of the sweep. Required in Sweep mode. min 1000. Applies when solveMode is "sweep". Not on the web form, which has an editor for it — give it here as described

freqStop.description: Sweep Stop (Hz). Upper bound of the sweep. Required in Sweep mode. min 1000. Applies when solveMode is "sweep". Not on the web form, which has an editor for it — give it here as described

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

ground.description: Ground. Object {type: free_space | perfect | finite}, plus epsilonR and conductivity (S/m) when finite. Omit for free space. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

groundType.description: Closed-Form Ground. Ground the closed-form model assumes. Instant only. omit for the default of "free_space". Applies when solveMode is "instant". Advanced — most callers can leave it out

optimize.description: Search Settings. Object {populationSize: a multiple of 4 between 8 and 200, generations: 1 to 200, lengthRange, spacingRange} for the NSGA-II search. Applies when solveMode is "optimize". Advanced — most callers can leave it out

randomSeed.description: Random Seed. Blank derives the seed from the parameters, so the same job repeats exactly. Set it to draw a different sample of the same design. min 0. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

referenceImpedance.description: Reference Impedance (Ω). Impedance the reported VSWR and reflection coefficient are referred to. min 0.1. omit for the default of 50. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

solveMode.description: Solve Mode. Instant is a closed-form textbook model of a preset. Standard solves your geometry with NEC-2 at one frequency; Sweep solves it across a band; Optimize searches element lengths and spacings. omit for the default of "instant". Paid tier only: optimize.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

wires.description: Wire Geometry. Wire segments of the antenna. Required for every mode but Instant. Array of {start:[x,y,z] in metres, end:[x,y,z] in metres, radius in metres, segments}. Each segment must be no longer than λ/10 and no shorter than 8 wire radii. Not on the web form, which has an editor for it — give it here as described

title: Wire Antenna Simulator (NEC-2)
